title: Payoff Desk Guidance on the Quote Amount for Trade-In Shortfall Payments
content:
A traded vehicle's **Trade-In Agreements** ledger may hold several payoff quotes. The coverage payoff figure, the quote amount the customer's shortfall payment is figured on, depends on how the latest quote compares with the highest quote amount on the agreement's ledger.

## Rule

| Highest quote amount on the ledger compared with the latest quote amount | Coverage payoff figure |
|---|---|
| Higher by more than the latest quote's per diem multiplied by 30 | The highest quote amount |
| Higher by a smaller positive amount (up to and including the latest per diem multiplied by 30) | The average of the highest and the latest quote amounts, rounded to the nearest cent |
| No quote exceeds the latest one | The latest quote amount |

The quote-drop line is the latest quote's per diem multiplied by 30 days.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

Latest quote $15000.00 with a per diem of $4.00; the line is $4.00 multiplied by 30, which is $120.00.

| Highest quote on the ledger | Excess over the latest | Coverage payoff figure |
|---|---|---|
| $15200.00 | $200.00, more than $120.00 | $15200.00 |
| $15120.00 | $120.00, not more than $120.00 | $15060.00 (average) |
| $15090.00 | $90.00 | $15045.00 (average) |
| $15000.00 (the latest itself) | none | $15000.00 |
